frontmatter_snapshot.summary: In an equilibrium with extrapolators (who expect future price changes as a weighted average of recent past changes) and boundedly-rational fundamental traders, prices are anchored to fundamentals plus an extrapolation term, generating bubbles, excess volatility, and time-series predictability.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Extrapolative Beliefs and Asset Prices
